events.name: form_start
events.fires_when: The user first interacts with an eligible form.
does_not_fire_when: The form is on an ineligible route

events.name: form_submit
events.fires_when: The website accepts the form submission and returns a successful technical response.
events.business_interpretation: Technical submission succeeded; not automatically a lead.

events.name: generate_lead
events.fires_when: A valid lead has been successfully received by the approved first-party backend.
does_not_fire_when: Only a form submit was attempted
The backend success condition is unverified

events.name: phone_click
events.fires_when: The user activates an approved tracked telephone CTA.
does_not_fire_when: The telephone number is merely visible
events.business_interpretation: Intent signal; not automatically a lead.

events.name: email_click
events.fires_when: The user activates an approved tracked email CTA.

events.name: appointment_request
events.fires_when: An approved appointment-request action successfully completes according to the verified backend success condition.
does_not_fire_when: The backend success condition is unverified
events.business_interpretation: Appointment-request stage; not a booked appointment.

events.name: cta_click
events.fires_when: The user activates a configured, approved non-contact CTA.
